_comment: Whitechain Mainnet (chainId 1875). Not in superchain-registry. Addresses from whitechain-labs/whitechain-bootstrap mainnet/l1-addresses.json and intent.toml, cross-checked on Ethereum mainnet 2026-11-23 (SystemConfig 4.0.0 minBaseFee 0, isCustomGasToken true, Portal 5.8.0 balance 0 ethLockbox unset, ASR 3.9.0, DGF 1.6.1 owner = the PAO Safe, respectedGameType 5 with gameImpls(5) the only registered game, SuperchainConfig 2.4.3 own not shared, DelayedWETH 1.5.1, PAO Safe v1.5.0 3-of-5 nonce 0 all plain-EOA owners). The chain was deployed directly at op-contracts/v8.0.0: no U19/U20 task was ever needed, which is why the Safe nonce is 0. NOTE: the original deployment also created an UNWIRED ETHLockbox proxy 0xBEDFe5233e7A57Ef396ba7B4292BE32A7782097D (version 1.3.1); portal.ethLockbox() is zero, so U21 deploys a FRESH lockbox and the old proxy stays unreferenced. It is intentionally absent from this file.
